character: Car-free, pedestrian-only resort built into the cliffs. Futuristic architecture (designed by Jean-Marc Legand, 1960s). All accommodation is ski-in/ski-out. Horses for transport (no cars). Heart of Portes du Soleil (650km). Aquariaz spa — largest indoor tropical spa in the Alps with waterfall, wave pool, 6 slides. Cinema, ice rink, bowling, luge 3300m (Europe's longest summer luge).
dining: La Cabane des Trappeurs (igloo restaurant). Le Yeti. La Grange. Le 1976. Piste-side mountain restaurants.
shopping: Pedestrian-only. Grocery, bakery, sports rental, shops. Horse-drawn carriage to move luggage.
apres_scene: Le R'K (nightclub). Le Yak. Les Enfants du Soleil. Bars on the main square. Car-free atmosphere.
activities_nearby: Aquariaz spa (indoor tropical pool, waterfalls, waterslides). Ice rink. Cinema. Luge (summer). Snowpark (La Crozets — one of Europe's best). Bowling. Paragliding. Hiking. 650km Portes du Soleil.
